# skill-linter

> Lints agent skill folders (SKILL.md) against the Agent Skills format: frontmatter, name rules, description limits, trigger cues and broken links. Python package `trysac-skill-linter`, import name `skill_linter`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules of the package
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
